note: Copy Layout Builder section adds Copy/Paste links to Layout Builder sections; it deep-clones the section (new component UUIDs, duplicated inline block_content + paragraphs) via a private tempstore buffer (collection lb_copy_section, key copied_section). No settings/schema/plugins/Drush; its only persistent surface is the single permission 'copy paste sections' (lb_copy_section.permissions.yml), which gates both the links (CopySectionRender::preRender) and the routes lb_copy_section.copy / lb_copy_section.paste. Depends on layout_builder. Copy/paste itself is user-interactive over AJAX and not scriptable in a stable verify, so medium/hard cases are grounded in the permission: medium seeds roles and the agent reads which role has the permission; hard has the agent grant the permission / create a role with it, verified via Role::hasPermission. All roles namespaced lbcs_*.

evals.prompt: I installed the lb_copy_section (Copy Layout Builder section) module but editors don't see any Copy/Paste links in Layout Builder. What permission do I need to grant, and what is its machine name?
evals.expected_output: Grant the 'copy paste sections' permission (label 'Copy/paste sections') to the editor role. It is the module's only permission and gates both the Copy/Paste links and the copy/paste routes. There is no other configuration.

evals.prompt: When I paste a Layout Builder section copied with lb_copy_section, is the pasted section's inline (custom) block the same entity as the original, or a new independent one? How does the module handle that?
evals.expected_output: It becomes a new, independent copy. The paste path deep-clones the section (DeepCloningTrait): every SectionComponent gets a new UUID and each InlineBlock's referenced block_content entity is createDuplicate()d (recursively, including referenced paragraphs), stored back as block_serialized, so the pasted inline block is a separate entity from the original.

evals.prompt: In the lb_copy_section module, where is a copied Layout Builder section stored between clicking Copy and Paste, and does that let you paste onto a different page?
evals.expected_output: The copied Section is stored in the current user's private tempstore (collection 'lb_copy_section', key 'copied_section'). Because the buffer is per-user and not tied to a page, you can paste the copied section onto any other page you edit in the same session. Requires the layout_builder module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which non-administrator role has been given the ability to copy and paste Layout Builder sections (the lb_copy_section feature)? Inspect the live roles/permissions to answer.
evals.expected_output: The lbcs_editor role has the 'copy paste sections' permission (user.role.lbcs_editor lists it), so its members see the Copy/Paste links. (The administrator role also has it implicitly as a superuser.)

evals.prompt: This site has two custom roles, lbcs_can and lbcs_cannot. Exactly one of them can copy/paste Layout Builder sections via lb_copy_section. Inspect the live permission configuration and state which role has that ability.
evals.expected_output: lbcs_can has the 'copy paste sections' permission; lbcs_cannot does not. So only lbcs_can members get the Copy/Paste links.

evals.prompt: This site has a role 'lbcs_grant' that cannot yet copy/paste Layout Builder sections. Using the lb_copy_section module's permission, grant that role the ability to copy and paste sections, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Grant the 'copy paste sections' permission to the lbcs_grant role (e.g. drush role:perm:add lbcs_grant 'copy paste sections', or Role::load('lbcs_grant')->grantPermission('copy paste sections')->save()). Role::hasPermission('copy paste sections') then returns TRUE.

evals.prompt: Create a new user role with the machine name 'lbcs_paster' and give it exactly the ability to copy and paste Layout Builder sections provided by the lb_copy_section module. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create the role lbcs_paster and grant it the 'copy paste sections' permission (Role::create(['id'=>'lbcs_paster','label'=>'...'])->grantPermission('copy paste sections')->save()). The role then exists and hasPermission('copy paste sections') is TRUE.
